audit.whatIsWrong: content.win reads Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Skill / Skill; CHAMP_FULL.phases reads Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia / Sejuani / Sejuani. They disagree on four of seven stages.
audit.why: The mirror audit at audits/top/sejuani__cassiopeia.json already settled this from the other side: Cassiopeia owns levels 1-5 outright on range and sustained damage, and from 6 it is Skill because Petrifying Gaze arriving is a spike for her, not for Sejuani. The content chart is the better read and the two directions must not contradict.
audit.corrected: CHAMP_FULL.phases should be brought to the content chart. Not proposed as edits — single-word side values cannot move inside the length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appears in the entry, and the level 6 spike leans entirely on "use R to interrupt her engage" without saying what either ultimate costs to spend.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 and Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80 at 825 range. Grounding one Arctic Assault at rank 1 is an eighteen-second window with no engage; spending a 120-second R on poke instead of on her commit is the mistake that loses the lane. Both numbers are missing.
audit.corrected: 18s, 120s, 650 and 825 written into spikes[1].text, wants.you[0], whys[1], early, mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) Arctic Assault is called Sejuani's E in spikes[1].text, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0] and early. Arctic Assault is her Q; Permafrost is the E. A reader tracking the wrong slot will track the wrong cooldown — 18s versus 1.5s. (b) wants.you[0], whys[1] and late say Miasma's grounding disables Glacial Prison. Glacial Prison is a thrown bola, not a movement ability; grounding does nothing to it, and telling a player their cloud stops her ultimate will get them caught.
audit.why: Riot: Arctic Assault (Q) — "Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air", 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, range 650. Permafrost (E) — "freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks", 1.5s. Glacial Prison (R) — "Sejuani throws her bola", flagged projectile. Miasma grounds movement abilities only.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere, and the Glacial Prison grounding claim replaced with the truth: the bola still flies.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in the first person — "Early belongs to me", "I sit at the tip of my Q", "a chained CC means I am dead". Every other Cassiopeia entry is second person. Also, Frost Armor granting slow immunity is never mentioned.
audit.why: The voice break is jarring and it is the only entry in the slice that does it. And Frost Armor matters mechanically: it grants "immunity to slows" out of combat, so Miasma's slow is worth nothing against a Sejuani who has been left alone — keeping poison on her is what strips it.
audit.corrected: All three prose fields rewritten in second person; Frost Armor slow immunity stated in early.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze (R) is a hard stun if she faces you — use it to interrupt her Arctic Assault (E) engage or freeze her in your poison so you E her down before she lands the Permafrost detonation.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (R) is a hard stun if she faces you at 825 — use it on her Arctic Assault (Q) charge, an 18s engage, so you Twin Fang her down before Permafrost (E) detonates the Frost stacks.

edits.before: Lay W (Miasma) on her path to GROUND her — it disables her Arctic Assault (E) dash and her Glacial Prison (R) so she can't engage on you
edits.after: Lay W (Miasma) on her path to ground her — it kills the Arctic Assault (Q) charge for 18s, though the Glacial Prison bola still flies

edits.before: Walk you down with Arctic Assault (E) and detonate Permafrost for the stun, then all-in or hold you for a jungle gank
edits.after: Charge in with Arctic Assault (Q) and detonate Permafrost (E) for the stun, then all-in or hold you for a jungle gank

edits.before: W (Miasma) grounds her Arctic Assault dash and Glacial Prison, neutering her only engage tools while you keep poking from range — the lane stays yours.
edits.after: W (Miasma) grounds the Arctic Assault charge for its whole 18s, neutering her one engage tool while you keep poking from range — the lane stays yours.

edits.before: Early belongs to me. Sejuani is a slow, immobile tank with no point-and-click harass, so I sit at the tip of my Q, poison her, and chain Twin Fang every time she steps up to farm. She has nothing to trade back at range. My key tool is W (Miasma): the GROUND on it disables her Arctic Assault (E) dash, so if she tries to all-in I drop my cloud on her path and she's stuck walking through poison. I keep my Serpentine Grace move speed rolling, deny her CS, and bully the levels she's weakest.
edits.after: Early belongs to you. Sejuani is a slow, immobile tank with no point-and-click harass, so sit at the tip of your Q, poison her, and chain Twin Fang every time she steps up to farm. She has nothing to trade back at range. Your key tool is W (Miasma): grounding kills the Arctic Assault (Q) charge, so drop the cloud on her path and she walks through poison for 18 seconds. Note Frost Armor makes her slow-immune out of combat, so keep the poison on her and it never comes back.

edits.before: Around 6 it tightens. She wants to land Arctic Assault, detonate Permafrost for the stun, and either all-in or hold me for a gank — so I respect her engage range and keep W ready to ground the dash. My power window is my own R: I hold Petrifying Gaze for when she faces me mid-commit, stun her, and chain Twin Fang through my poison while she's frozen. I don't dump R early just to poke — if I waste it she walks me down on a free engage. I still out-trade her one-on-one here as long as I don't get caught flat-footed.
edits.after: Around 6 it tightens. She wants to land Arctic Assault (Q), detonate Permafrost (E) for the stun, and either all-in or hold you for a gank — so respect her 650 charge range and keep Miasma ready to ground it. Your power window is your own R: hold Petrifying Gaze for when she faces you mid-commit, stun her at 825, and chain Twin Fang through the poison. Do not dump a 120-second R just to poke — waste it and she walks you down on a free engage. You still out-trade her one-on-one if you are not caught flat-footed.

edits.before: This is where she takes over. She finishes tank items, maxes Winter's Wrath, and turns into a resisted wall that my single-target Twin Fang can't chew through, while her percent-max-HP W keeps chipping me. Her Glacial Prison (R) plus the Permafrost-detonation stun catch me, and since I buy no boots and have no dash, a chained CC means I'm dead. I stop trying to 1v1 her — I group, save W to ground her engage onto my carries, peel myself with R, and use my poison to delete the squishies she's diving instead of trading into her HP bar.
edits.after: This is where she takes over. She finishes tank items, maxes Winter's Wrath, and turns into a resisted wall your single-target Twin Fang cannot chew through, while her percent-max-HP W keeps chipping you. Glacial Prison is a thrown bola on 120s — grounding does not stop it, and with no dash a chained stun kills you. Stop trying to 1v1 her: group, hold Miasma to ground the Arctic Assault charge onto your carries, peel yourself with R, and use the poison to delete the squishies she dives.
